ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, shareholders, gérants and funding counterparties against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the US OFAC SDN List, and the French national asset-freezing measures (Tracfin / PAAC gels d'avoirs); mandatory PEP determination under Article L. 561-10-2 CMF with enhanced due diligence requiring senior-management sign-off, independent source-of-funds validation and enhanced transaction monitoring; screening is performed at onboarding, before each capital drawdown and continuously through the incorporation period, with results archived in the compliance data room supporting the AEO supply-chain audit file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique Électronique des Formalités d'Entreprises operated by the INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), with name availability verified against the RNCS via data.inpi.fr
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name (dénomination sociale) must appear in the statutes in French; where the chosen name is non-French, a mandatory French-language legal denomination must be created and disclosed under the Toubon Law (Loi n° 94-665 of 4 August 1994). Any non-Latin script requires a statutory Latin-script transliteration and compliance with the orthotypographic rules of the RCS. The name must not infringe prior third-party corporate names or trademarks, must not mislead as to the nature, scope or regulated credentials of the business, and on all commercial documents must be followed by the legal form 'SARL', registered capital, RCS number and registered office particulars.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: AEO / OEA (Opérateur Économique Agréé) — reserved to customs-accredited operators; misleading use by a consultancy is barred
Douane / Customs — implies official customs authority
France / République / National / Officiel — implies a State emanation
Banque / Bank — requires ACPR authorization and minimum capital
Assurance / Insurance — requires French insurance regulatory authorization
Bourse / Chambre de commerce / Commissaire aux comptes / Avocat — reserved or regulated professional terms
Capital — restricted where the company does not meet the minimum capital prerequisites attached to the term
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection the Guichet Unique issues a reasoned refusal within 10 working days; the applicant may (i) file an amended incorporation form correcting the offending token within the 30-day window, (ii) request written reconsideration from the INPI registry directorate, or (iii) bring summary proceedings (référé) before the competent commercial court to compel registration where the refusal is unlawful; if rejection arises from a prior third-party name, the attorney negotiates a coexistence or renunciation instrument from the prior registered holder before re-filing the amended corporate name within the same 30-day validity period.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this non-regulated consultancy under Articles L. 123-11-2 and R. 123-236 of the French Commercial Code, provided the entity executes a domiciliation agreement with an approved société de domiciliation, maintains a minimum contractual term of three months (renewable), designates an administrative correspondence office in French territory, and satisfies DGFiP substance expectations for tax residency under Article 8 of the French General Tax Code; a physical AEO-audit workroom or documented remote-work business substance is recommended to defend commercial credibility and readiness for future AEO certification mandates.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspection: 60% within the first 24 months of operation — DGFiP VAT and corporate income tax verification visits and French customs (direction régionale des douanes) verification visits are common for service companies entering the AEO advisory space; the likelihood increases materially where early VAT credits or customs-consulting invoices are presented for refund or offset.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.210-1 et seq. (general company provisions), L.223-1 to L.223-43 (Société à Responsabilité Limitée / SARL), Decree No. 84-406 of 30 May 1984 (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés), and Order No. 2023-393 (single-window filing regime).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry), operating the Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) through the INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) together with the CERFA M0 form (Demande d'immatriculation d'une personne morale), filed electronically via the INPI single-window portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital for an SARL (may be set at EUR 1). Each cash contribution must be paid in to at least 20% (one-fifth) at formation, with the balance payable within five years; cash funds must be deposited with a licensed French bank or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (escrow) before RCS registration, and in-kind contributions must be fully paid up at incorporation and valued by a commissaire aux apports if the contribution exceeds EUR 30,000 or on shareholder request.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED unanimously by the founders subscribing to the entire share capital of the SARL, that the draft Statuts dated [●] are hereby adopted and the registered office is fixed at [●], with power to relocate subject to board approval. RESOLVED FURTHER that the cash capital, representing at least one-fifth of each contribution, has been deposited in the escrow bank and that the Gérants named in the Statuts are appointed for an indefinite term with authority to open bank accounts, complete the RCS M0 filing, and assume all customs AEO and supply-chain security obligations on behalf of the Company. RESOLVED FINALLY that all preparatory acts, including the legal publication and any auditor appointment, are ratified, and the Gérants are authorized to sign all registration instruments, tax declarations, and regulatory filings. RESOLVED that the agenda is hereby closed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Clearance and Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI national trademark database and Infogreffe RCS name database (online public portals).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a pre-filing search in the INPI and Infogreffe databases to confirm the proposed corporate name is available and enforceable as a distinctive sign; reserve the corresponding domain name if needed. Prepare a written name-clearance memo for the file.
required_dossiers: Corporate purpose statement (ISIC 7020 management consulting and AEO security audit)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name conflicts with an existing RCS entry or INPI trademark, file an opposition response or amend the name suffix/logo; re-run the clearance search before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders acting by private deed or before a Notaire; optional commissaire aux apports for in-kind contributions.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft French-language Statuts specifying the corporate form (SARL), duration (99 years maximum), corporate object (management consulting, supply-chain compliance, customs AEO security auditing), share capital, share allocation, mode of management, and dispute resolution. Execute a signed original for each shareholder.
required_dossiers: In-kind contribution valuation report, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry objects to a clause, amend the Statuts by supplementary resolution and re-sign; obtain notarial certification if the discrepancy concerns real property contribution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Temporary Bank Account and Escrow Deposit of Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary corporate account in the name of the SARL in formation; deposit at least 20% of each cash contribution (or the full subscribed amount if required by the Statuts). Obtain the banker's attestation of funds blockage (attestation de blocage des fonds) to be surrendered to the registry upon registration.
required_dossiers: Shareholders' KYC files (passport and proof of address)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank delays, issue a formal reminder and escalate to the bank's commercial department; alternatively deposit funds with the CDC and obtain a CDC attestation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of Legal Notice (Avis de Constitution) in a Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) admitted in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish a mandatory incorporation notice containing the corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, and the names of the Gérants. Request the JAL attestation of publication, which must accompany the RCS filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any typographical discrepancies by issuing a rectificative notice; the JAL may reprint within 24 hours on payment of a nominal fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Dossier with the INPI Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises, transmitting to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for RCS registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit the CERFA M0 form electronically via the INPI portal, attaching the executed Statuts, proof of publication, bank attestation, and power of attorney if the filing is made by a representative. Pay the applicable greffe fees via the portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a request for regularization (demande de complément), submit the missing documents within the prescribed 15-day period through the INPI portal; appeal to the competent court only after exhausting curative filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration and Issuance of Kbis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / RCS (Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Greffe assigns the SIREN, SIRET and NAF code (7020Z) and issues the official Kbis extract constituting conclusive proof of legal existence. Verify the accuracy of the Kbis data and request corrections if necessary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File a request for rectification with the Greffe; if the registry refuses, petition the supervising judge (juge commis à la surveillance du registre).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Governance, Tax and Social Security Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF, DREETS, INSEE, Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), and the local business formalities office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete social-security registration of the Gérant and employees, obtain the corporate compliance registers (shareholders register, minutes book), open the DGFiP tax accounts, register for VAT if applicable, and adopt the AEO supply-chain security audit compliance manual. Issue the corporate seal using the registered legal name and RCS number.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of managers and employees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If URSSAF or DGFiP queries the file, respond via the dedicated business portal within the statutory time limit; correct any mismatched identifiers by requesting an INSEE coordination file.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial operating license is required for ISIC 7020 management-consulting and audited AEO supply-chain compliance activities; workplace compliance is supervised by the DREETS (Direction régionale de l'économie, de l'emploi, du travail et des solidarités) and voluntary customs authorization is administered by the DGDDI (Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects), in coordination with the CCI (Chambre de Commerce et d'Industrie) for trade facilitation.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Kbis extract (RCS registration certificate) as the general business authorization; optional Authorized Economic Operator – Customs Simplifications (AEO-C / AEO-S, now 'AEOF') certificate issued by DGDDI under Articles 38 and 39 of the Union Customs Code for security and safety audit credentialing.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique / DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – office-based professional activity not listed under the ICPE nomenclature (Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement); no registration, no prior EIA report, and no environmental operating permit required for the Paris-region or provincial consulting office.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office premises generate no regulated industrial wastewater or VOC emissions; compliance with municipal domestic-waste collection conventions, the extended-producer-responsibility rules for electrical and electronic office equipment (Article L.541-10 of the Environmental Code), and green building waste-sorting obligations under the 2015 Energy Transition Law.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety compliance of the office premises under the Code de la Construction et de l'Habitation (ERP third-category escape routes, fire extinguisher inspection), electrical-installation conformity certificate, DREETS occupational-health-and-safety inspection under the Code du Travail, annual employee safety training, and, for AEO certification, physical security controls including access management, CCTV, tamper-evident procedures and structured supply-chain security screening for the audited customs facility.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), official portal https://www.impots.gouv.fr/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SARL obtains SIREN/SIRET via INSEE registration; foreign-owned entities register with DGFiP for VAT identification number if taxable turnover exceeds €35,000, appointing a fiscal representative where non-resident ownership applies
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; subject to French territorial tax regime (since 2019) for large enterprises and hybrid mismatch rules under EU ATAD directive

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facture Électronique de Tiers (FET) for all B2B transactions since 1 October 2024; real-time API transmission to DGFiP with digital time-stamping and clearance

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for goods exported outside the EU or offshore services supplied to non-EU customers; eligibility requires proof of export commencing within 180 days of invoice date
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or equivalent proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims result in full VAT liability, interest, fines up to 80% of evaded tax, and potential criminal prosecution with retrospective adjustments

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Paris) - the national central bank and balance-of-payments statistical authority - acting jointly with the Direction Generale du Tresor (French Treasury, Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty) under the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monetaire et financier, Articles L. 151-1 et seq. and R. 152-1 et seq.). Day-to-day prudential supervision of credit institutions, payment institutions and e-money institutions rests with the ACPR (Autorite de Controle Prudentiel et de Resolution) in coordination with the European Central Bank under France's Eurosystem membership.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full current-account and capital-account convertibility for all IMF Article VIII operations. No prior authorisation, licence or central bank foreign-exchange approval is required for capital injections into a French SARL by non-resident shareholders, for invoicing of overseas AEO clients, for profit/dividend remittance or liquidation proceeds to foreign shareholders, or for maintenance of foreign-currency accounts at home or abroad. The operative constraint is declarative rather than permissive: every cross-border financial flow must be reported by the resident company or its banking counterpart to the Banque de France within 20 days after the end of the month in which the flow occurs, using the authorised purpose codes of the French balance-of-payments nomenclature. Profit-repatriation hurdles are confined to corporate and fiscal formalities: dividends require a shareholders' approval and the closure of accounts; distributions to non-EU/EEA residents attract a 25% withholding tax unless reduced by treaty; qualifying EU/EEA corporate shareholders may claim the 0% Parent-Subsidiary Directive exemption supported by a certificate of tax residence and beneficial-ownership statement. No exchange commission, residual surrender duty or convertibility fee is imposed on the AEO consultancy's ordinary cross-border flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no export-proceeds surrender, no mandatory repatriation timeline and no statutory conversion ratio. Exporters and cross-border service suppliers may retain receipts indefinitely in any currency, including on foreign-currency bank accounts, provided the associated operation is declared in the Banque de France monthly balance-of-payments statement using the service-revenue operation code for ISIC 7020 / AEO supply-chain consulting, and invoice plus SWIFT confirmation evidence is retained for the statutory six-year preservation period. French customs law is indifferent to the payment rail; AEO certification and supply-chain audit services are invoiced as services, not merchandise exports, and therefore no export-receipt declaration in the sense used by French customs (declaration en douane de marchandises) is applicable.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Treasury Account plus capital-blocking/escrow sub-account and USD/CNH multi-currency sub-accounts
Operational Treasury Account plus FX derivatives collateral account and SEPA/instant clearing overlay

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: LCL (Credit Lyonnais), member of the Credit Agricole Group
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with authorised overdraft perimeter and trade-finance support
Operational Account with documentary collection and commercial LC handling capability
Cross-border multi-currency Operational Account (EUR/USD/CNH) with dedicated global treasury overlay
Retail-grade Operational Account limited to SEPA rails; insufficient for cross-border treasury and FX

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High operational viability as an ancillary cross-border settlement rail; Medium legal viability as the sole primary treasury account. Wise (Wise Europe SA, passported into France under PSD2) and other EEA-licensed EMIs such as Revolut Business, Qonto and Shine can be onboarded fully remotely within one to three days and are cost-effective for low-value, high-frequency disbursements such as consultant fees, software subscriptions and travel expenses. Legal constraints: (i) an EMI cannot extend credit, hold client funds as deposits, issue commercial letters of credit or bank guarantees, provide custody, or execute bilateral FX forwards and swaps unless separately authorised; (ii) funds held at an EMI are safeguarded rather than covered by the French deposit-guarantee scheme, so a material balance above EUR 100,000 is inadvisable; (iii) French tax and customs AEO audits are channel-agnostic but require the underlying economic documentation, VAT records, and accurate payment instructions, all of which must remain recoverable; (iv) for a newly incorporated SARL with non-resident ownership, EMIs apply essentially the same KYC evidence standard as tier-1 banks. Recommended treasury architecture: tier-1 French bank as the zero-balance/sweep anchor for capital injection, hedging and strategic payments; Wise as the dedicated rail for small-value cross-border disbursements and FX conversion; SWIFT MT103 from the tier-1 bank for any single payment above EUR 50,000.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law (Code monetaire et financier Articles L. 561-5 and L. 561-7, with ACPR guidance DOC-2018-08) permits both physical and remote identification, and remote onboarding is accepted where the digital identity verification engine is certified by ANSSI and the beneficial owner is an EEA/EU resident. In practice, however, French tier-1 banks apply a conservative business rule for a SARL whose shareholders reside outside the EEA or whose ownership is held through an intermediate legal entity: at least one legal representative (gerant) with signing authority must attend a physical interview at a branch, presenting a valid passport, proof of business address, proof of the SARL's commercial substance and the original or notarised copy of the corporate statutes. Fully remote opening is generally feasible only for EEA-resident directors and straightforward single-director structures. The AEO consultancy should therefore assume the baseline of one physical visit per non-EEA gerant at a Paris or Lyon flagship branch, plus biometric passport verification, an apostilled UBO declaration, and the filing of an ANSSI-certified video-identity record where the bank permits hybrid onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership with an opaque intermediate layer: the ultimate beneficial owner cannot be verified from the RCS extract, or an intermediate holding company is situated in an FATF-monitored or EU-listed high-risk jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised and apostilled REBE UBO declaration filed with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; full organisational chart tracing each shareholder layer to named individuals; official IDs and passports of each UBO; tax-residence certificates of the 100% shareholders; the SARL's SIREN/SIRET and KBIS extract; a French notary's attestation of the corporate powers; and a board minute demonstrating the commercial substance and reason for the intermediate holding structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: First-injection concern: a one-off cross-border capital contribution received from a non-resident bank in a high-risk country before the company has an operating history, or routed through a bank account that does not belong to the named shareholder.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised shareholders' resolution earmarking the wiring as a capital subscription or associate current-account advance; the complete SWIFT MT103/MT199 chain proving the originator equals the subscribing shareholder; contributor's bank statements covering the source of funds; sworn source-of-wealth statement before a French notaire; certificate of deposit of share capital (attestation de depot des fonds) issued by the receiving credit institution; the SARL's constitutive documents and the Guichet Unique acknowledgement of the capital increase; any required foreign-exchange approval from the sending jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Routing of early-stage AEO consulting invoices through Wise or another EMI before the primary tier-1 bank account is active, combined with a service scope adjacent to dual-use goods, customs security auditing or supply-chain compliance that triggers enhanced export-control screening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Underlying consultancy contracts with measurable deliverables and completion certificates; the SARL's AEO certificate and ISO 28000 / TAPA FSR certifications where held; itemised commercial invoices identifying each payee and payer; the EMI's legal-entity identifier, e-money licence number and home-regulator reference; full transaction histories from the EMI account; and a dual-use classifier matrix demonstrating that the services never facilitate transfers of controlled goods to sanctioned end-users, supported by a written AMLD6/Code monetaire et financier risk assessment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Political-exposure or sanctions-related flags: any legal representative, shareholder or material client has prior public-sector exposure - French customs and supply-chain advisers may be classified as politically exposed persons - or appears in a negative sanctions or export-control screening list.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Time-stamped sanctions screening reports covering the EU Council consolidated lists, OFAC SDN, UN Security Council and French national freezes for all counterparties; documented negative PEP declarations; a written client-acceptance and KYC policy formally approved by the SARL; legal opinions from a French avocat confirming the no-sanctions-circumvention analysis under EU Regulation 833/2014 and the French Internal Security Code export-control provisions; and monthly rescreening evidence demonstrating a continuously updated compliance programme.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol for equity and associate-current-account inflows. (1) Wiring: the non-resident shareholder transmits a SWIFT MT103 from its own bank account to the SARL's EUR IBAN at the French tier-1 bank, with the purpose narrative limited to 'souscription au capital social' or 'avance en compte courant d'associe'; the originator name must match the subscriber in the notarised resolution. (2) Reporting: the receiving bank and the SARL file the monthly Banque de France balance-of-payments declaration using the French BOP operation code for share-capital subscription or associate current-account movements; the declaration obligation is met within 20 days of month-end. (3) Blocking and release: funds intended as share capital must be deposited with the credit institution or a notary and remain blocked until the SARL is registered or the capital increase is filed with the RCS via the Guichet Unique; upon production of the KBIS extract the funds are released for operational use. (4) Verification: banks may detain the inflow for up to five business days for enhanced due diligence on amounts above EUR 10,000 and will request the shareholders' resolution, passport copies, bank statements of the contributor, source-of-funds declaration and the attestation de depot des fonds. No prior Banque de France or ECB authorisation is required for the injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Preferred clearing rails for a French AEO consultancy: SEPA Credit Transfer (XML ISO 20022) for EUR-denominated EU/EEA payments with value date T+1; SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst, execution in under ten seconds, single-transaction limit EUR 100,000) for urgent fees and small vendor settlements; and SWIFT MT103 for non-EEA or non-EUR settlements, each instruction carrying the relevant Banque de France BOP purpose code for business and management consulting services or dividend distribution. For the rare goods-related security-audit mandates, a Commercial Letter of Credit under UCP 600 - issued or transferred via SWIFT MT700/MT707 - and documentary collections under URC 522 remain permissible auxiliary rails; however, a pure ISIC 7020 consultancy should use ordinary value-dated SWIFT/SEPA transfers to avoid document checks. Dividend remittances to foreign shareholders are executed by SWIFT MT103 with the BOP code for dividends and, where applicable, the French withholding tax return (Cerfa n 2557).
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla OTC FX forwards (forward outright) executed with a French tier-1 bank under an ISDA or FBF master agreement, tenors up to 24 months, permitted for hedging AEO consulting invoices denominated in USD, GBP or CNH against the EUR functional currency, subject to EMIR and MiFID II suitability and underlying-exposure requirements.

FX swaps (combination of a spot leg and forward leg) permitted for temporary EUR/USD or EUR/CNH liquidity bridging where the treasury holds a matching receivable or payable flow and the position is not speculative.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) permissible only where a material long-term funding or a long-dated commercial contract creates a genuine exposure; in practice this is beyond the operating profile of an ISIC 7020 consultancy and is marked not-recommended.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) permissible strictly for hedging exposure in non-convertible or restricted currencies appearing on the BIS non-deliverable list (e.g., INR, VND, BRL, KRW), executed only with a licensed EEA credit institution and without any deliverable settlement in France.

Purchase of European-style vanilla FX options (net premium debit) permissible as an asymmetric hedge against adverse currency movements; the writing or selling of options for premium income is treated as speculative and falls outside the permitted treasury mandate for a French SARL.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (comptes annuels), management report (rapport de gestion), and, when applicable, the independent auditor's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) acting as the body maintaining the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within seven months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SARL, the shareholders' meeting must approve the accounts by 30 June and the filing with the Registry must occur no later than 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts a civil penalty up to EUR 15,000, daily coercive fines (astreinte) ordered by the court, and, if the court order is disregarded, the Public Prosecutor may seek administrative strike-off (radiation) of the company from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (déclaration de résultats, form 2065-SD, with supporting schedules 2050A to 2059G)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months of fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SARL, due by 30 April of the subsequent year, with an automatic extension to the second working day after 30 April for e-filers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers late-payment interest of 0.2% per month and penalties of 5% per month on the tax due, capped at 10%; penalties rise to 40% for negligent failure and 80% for fraudulent default. The tax authority may assess an ex officio tax base and issue an enforcement notice; prolonged non-compliance may engage the manager's joint civil liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual re-affirmation of the beneficial ownership statement (représentation annuelle des bénéficiaires effectifs) lodged together with the annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry) – Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the annual financial statements, i.e., within one month of shareholder approval and, for a calendar-year SARL, no later than 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or incomplete beneficial-ownership data may cause the filing to be rejected, with an administrative penalty of EUR 100 to EUR 500; recurrent non-disclosure is treated as a registry-never-missed communication and can support strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (Commissaire aux comptes) must be appointed if the SARL exceeds at least two of three thresholds: total balance-sheet assets exceeding EUR 4,000,000; annual net turnover exceeding EUR 8,000,000; and an average workforce exceeding 50 employees.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général), as harmonised by the ANC regulations; IFRS is only allowed for consolidated financial statements of listed groups, not for the individual financial statements of an SARL.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The beneficial-ownership declaration must be filed at incorporation and updated within 30 days of any share transfer or change in effective control. France does not require a standalone annual UBO confirmation; instead, the annual accounts filing with the Greffe includes a representation of continued accuracy of the UBO register. The Registry performs cross-checks on each annual deposit.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (registre des parts sociales et des mouvements de titres)
Minute book containing minutes of shareholders' meetings and board/managerial decisions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 170–550 per year for registered-office domiciliation in France; additional service fees apply if a professional corporate-services agent is used.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,500–18,500 per year for a certified statutory audit for an SARL of comparable size and scope.

stage_6.entry_description: Legal name, SIREN/SIRET, registered office address, legal form (SARL), principal activity code NAF/APE, fiscal year opening and closing dates.
stage_6.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the French establishment's own identifying data; foreign shareholders are identified in the 'tableau des filiales et participations' annex. A zero-turnover dormant SARL must still file a nil return with the same identification.
